<thought>Based on the 13C NMR data, there is a carbon signal at ~54 ppm, which is characteristic of a methoxy (O‑CH₃) group, indicating at least one methyl group. The other low‑field carbon signal at ~44 ppm could correspond to a methyl attached to a heteroatom (e.g., N‑CH₃) or a methylene carbon; without further data it is ambiguous. To be conservative, I will count only the clearly identifiable methoxy methyl, giving a count of 1 CH₃ group.</thought>
<final_answer>1</final_answer>
